newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia in talks with Japanese on car factory - PM.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia in talks with Japanese on car factory - PM.

text.p: Slovakia is holding talks with an unspecified Japanese car maker on the construction of a car plant in Slovakia, Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said on Friday.

"We are negotiating with one car producer from Japan over creating a plant to complete cars in Slovakia according to Japanese design and documentation but from Slovak-made components," Meciar said in Trnava, western Slovakia.
He did not elaborate, but previous reports have linked Toyota Motor Corp to Slovakia.

Slovakia's largest steel producer, VSZ a.s., said last week it was talking to Nomura Securities Co Ltd about financing construction of a car assembly plant in Slovakia as part of VSZ's diversification strategy.
Last month VSZ Supervisory Board Chairman Alexander Rezes said VSZ was preparing extensive restructuring measures, partly in the hope of forging ties with Toyota.
Premier Meciar visited Japan earlier this year where he held talks with major Japanese industrial firms on investment prospects in Slovakia.
After a trip to Japan at the beginning of April, Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said Toyota was considering locating a car factory in eastern Slovakia.
Toyota has so far declined to comment on the project.
